explication: UnblockNeteaseMusic is a Node.js HTTP/HTTPS proxy that restores unavailable Netease Cloud Music tracks by matching them against alternate music providers. The main flow is client traffic through the proxy and Netease request hook, which invokes provider matching and returns a replacement audio URL; the proxy also supports general traffic forwarding, PAC, authentication, filtering, and relay configuration. Sampled source supports the main runtime calls; provider coverage and several proxy capabilities are documented in the README, while some provider implementations were not sampled.
